head: iOS 27 HDMI problem: video stops when you lock your iPhone
dek: On iOS 27, many iPhone owners report that video to an external display over HDMI stops once the phone is locked. GSMArena reproduced it with YouTube and Netflix; VLC still works.
details: iOS 27 requires apps to register external display video sessions themselves, which iOS used to do automatically, so apps need an update. There's no fix yet.
where: iPhones on iOS 27 with an HDMI adapter or video glasses
means: If you play video from your iPhone on a TV or video glasses, locking the phone now stops it in many apps.
todo: For now, keep the screen unlocked and turn down the brightness, or try VLC; update your video apps when fixes arrive.
